title: Show HN: RF Hunter – Find hidden cameras and other devices
guide_zh: RF Hunter 通过检测射频信号寻找隐藏摄像头及其他发射设备。
author: RamboRogers
excerpt: This project is an RF Signal Scanner built using an ESP32, AD8317 RF detector, and various other components. It's designed to detect and measure RF signals in the environment and display the signal strength on an OLED display. It's useful to find hidden cameras, wiretapping devices, and other RF-enabled devices.
